audit_questions.answer: Current pairIndex/index/openedAt are documented, but historical transaction/log IDs and stable lifecycle lineage are UNKNOWN. DOC_POSITIONS / DOC_INFO_API.
audit_questions.question: Is there a stable event/transaction/order/position identifier?

audit_questions.answer: DOCUMENTATION_ONLY. Full fee/PnL history is described, but per-event primitives and as-of completeness were not verified; no PnL was computed. DOC_HISTORY.

audit_questions.answer: UNVERIFIED. The current positions GET lacks an as-of argument; complete exposure events, historic quotes and fee state were not obtained. DOC_ACCOUNT_API.

audit_questions.answer: UNKNOWN: no proven first/last event, retention horizon or gap rate. Current top-10 leaderboard is not coverage evidence. DOC_INFO_API / PROBE_4.
audit_questions.question: What is the historical coverage?

audit_questions.answer: Documented page and limit path arguments, defaults 0 and 20. Maximum, ordering, completion and consistent-snapshot semantics UNKNOWN. DOC_INFO_API.

audit_questions.answer: UNKNOWN usable historical guarantees. Flashblock notifications are not assumed to be safe/final. Reviewed MAINNET Pusher key is unset; no key or stream was provisioned. DOC_ORDER_STREAM / DOC_CONFIG.
audit_questions.question: What finality/reorg/revision behavior exists?

audit_questions.answer: Must be the native filled-event timestamp with explicit unit and clock. This history field was not established. Current position openedAt is insufficient and its missing zero default is not accepted. DOC_POSITION_MODEL.
audit_questions.question: What is event_time?

audit_questions.answer: The local first successful receipt of a datum. These audit GETs retain actual receive-completion times. Old events fetched later must keep the later receipt, never the native event time.
audit_questions.question: What can honestly be called observed_at?

audit_questions.answer: A known local receipt, locally observed acceptable finality, and all prerequisites; use their maximum only when complete and consistent. Otherwise UNKNOWN. No historical availability is filled by a current GET.
audit_questions.question: What determines available_at?

audit_questions.answer: UNVERIFIED. This audit measured request durations only; no event-publication/indexing/finality delay or usable forward wallet event was captured. PROBE_2 through PROBE_5.
audit_questions.question: Could a forward observer receive events in time to follow?

audit_questions.answer: Info history is documented without a signer and several public GETs worked. A 403 leaves read-access requirements unresolved. A delegate API key grants trading authority and was neither created nor used. DOC_SECURITY / PROBE_5.
audit_questions.question: Does a required capability need authentication/signing?

audit_questions.answer: Yes for S01: standard-library offline processing and fixed public GET probes; execution SDK namespaces are never imported. No wallet, signing, deposit, withdrawal or order capability exists in this package. S01_BOUNDARY.
audit_questions.question: Can the source be audited without an order path?

provenance.claim: The public info surface accepts account addresses without signing. It describes fill history with fees, order history, recent pair trades and a leaderboard. These descriptions do not establish historical completeness, original delivery times or an as-of position snapshot.
provenance.title: Portfolio and History

provenance.claim: trade_history and order_history use GET /v2/history/{trade-history,order-history}/{trader}/{page}/{limit}, default page=0 and limit=20. recent_trades uses GET /v1/history/recent-trades/{pair_index}. Responses are untyped Any; numeric quotas, retention, stable paging order and history watermark are not specified here. A missing deployment endpoint can return 404.
provenance.title: InfoApi source

provenance.claim: Current account state exposes pair/index, side, collateral, leverage, opened_at and is_upside with accrued fee fields. The documented read describes current positions; it does not document a historical-boundary parameter.
provenance.title: Positions

provenance.claim: positions reads GET core/user-data with a trader parameter only. AccountApi also inherits execution functions, so S01 does not instantiate it or the root SDK client. No historical as-of parameter is exposed by this method.
provenance.title: AccountApi source

provenance.claim: Current positions expose trader, pairIndex, index, buy, isPnl, collateral, leverage and openedAt. Several missing values default to zero or false in the SDK, so they cannot be treated as evidence of observed zero fees or known native timestamps. The S01 timing interface preserves None.
provenance.title: Position model

provenance.claim: The current mainnet profile binds the history service to api.veranta.xyz, core/data to prod-api.veranta.xyz, and deployment metadata to tx-builder.veranta.xyz. MAINNET has no explicit Pusher key; NetworkProfile defaults it to None. S01 does not read SDK environment overrides.
provenance.title: Mainnet SDK configuration

provenance.claim: The SDK describes unsigned public per-trader Pusher channels and pickup, flashblock confirmation, filled and canceled notifications. The stream requires a deployment Pusher key.
